title: Why do spiders spin webs?
examples: Do spiders use their webs to build houses?
Is the spider web sticky or just strong?
What do spiders do if their web breaks?

explain.say: Spiders spin webs for many important reasons.
One main reason is for catching their food.
The silk they use is very strong material.
They also use webs to feel for vibrations.
In real life, you can see this with garden spiders.
A common mistake is thinking webs are only sticky.

faq.q: Do spiders use their webs to build houses?
faq.a: Spiders use webs for many things, but their main home is usually a small retreat or corner.
asks: Do they build a nest with webs?

faq.a: Yes, the silk has sticky parts that trap insects gently. However, it is also very strong.
asks: Is the stickiness the only job?

faq.q: What happens if a big animal touches the web?
faq.a: A big animal might break the web, but the spider can usually repair it with new silk threads.
No, some spiders, like jumping spiders, do not build large webs to catch food.
asks: Do all spiders catch food in webs?
Are there spider types without webs?

faq.q: How do spiders know where to put their web?
faq.a: They usually build webs between safe, sheltered places like leaves or branches.
asks: Do they plan where to build?

facts: Spider silk is one of the strongest natural materials known.
Spiders use vibrations in the web to detect prey.
Webs help spiders rest and feel safe from predators.
Some spiders hunt by jumping instead of using webs.

quiz.say: What is the primary purpose of the sticky part of the web?
quiz.why: The sticky threads are designed to trap passing food sources.

wrong.1: While they rest there, the main job is catching food.
wrong.2: Vibrations are felt, not used to make loud noises.
wrong.3: The web is more about trapping than scaring.

quiz.say: If a spider feels a strong shake on its web, what does it know?

options.show: It needs to spin more silk
options.say: It needs to spin more silk

quiz.why: The vibrations tell the spider that something has bumped into the web.

wrong.0: A shake could mean food, not just a warning to go.
wrong.1: A small shake might just be a passing breeze.
wrong.2: The shake tells it about the environment, not its supplies.

quiz.say: Which word best describes spider silk?
quiz.why: The silk must be strong enough to hold the web, and sticky enough to catch food.

wrong.1: If it was only sticky, it might tear when too much weight hit it.
wrong.2: If it was only strong, it would not trap the small insects.
wrong.3: While thin, the web is visible to us when it catches something.
